title: 残業・出張・会食禁止に「ぐうの音」も出ない中道・立憲の懐事情
extracted_text: 残業・出張・会食は原則禁止、照明も間引きして――。2月の衆院選で大敗した中道改革連合とそのあおりをうけた立憲民主党が「金欠」にあえいでいる。党の活動を支える政党交付金は大幅に減り、活動資金の余裕は一気になくなった。党首自ら「自腹」で公務に臨むなど厳しい節制に取り組むが、内部からは挽回を狙う次期国政選挙に向けて「これではまともに戦えない」との声も上がる。 「自費で行くことをもって現状の厳しさや、その中でも必要な役割を果たそうとする姿勢を明らかにしたい」。中道の小川淳也代表は4月10日の記者会見で、直後に迫ったスペインでの国際会議に「自腹」で出席する覚悟を口にした。「さまざまなご辛抱を党内外にお願いする立場」ゆえの決断という。約3日間の行程では、通常は代表に密着する党の随行職員の姿もなかった。
translated_text: Overtime work, business trips, and dining out are prohibited as a rule, and even the lights are being dimmed. The Centrist Reform Alliance, which suffered a major defeat in the February House of election, and the Constitutional Democratic Party, which was caught in its wake, are suffering from a cash crunch. Party subsidies that support the parties' activities have drastically decreased, and their financial flexibility has evaporated overnight. Party leaders themselves are taking strict austerity measures, such as covering official duties out of their own pockets. But from within the parties, voices are rising saying, "We can't properly fight in the next national election like this." "By paying out of my own pocket, I want to make clear the severity of the current situation and the stance of trying to fulfill necessary roles even in these circumstances." Centrist representative Junya Ogawa stated at a press conference on April 10 that he was prepared to attend an upcoming international conference in Spain at his own expense. He called it a decision forced by his position of "asking various sacrifices from both inside and outside the party." For the roughly three-day trip, there was no party staff member who would normally accompany the representative.
title_en: Cash-Strapped Centrist Reform Alliance Can't Even Complain About Overtime, Business Trips and Dining Out Bans
